family.description: Broad electrolyte class. organic: non-aqueous liquid electrolyte, including carbonate and ether systems; aqueous: water-based liquid electrolyte; ionic_liquid: room-temperature ionic liquid electrolyte; solid: inorganic or polymer solid electrolyte; gel: polymer-swollen liquid (gel polymer) electrolyte; hybrid: combination of two families; unknown: not stated.

solvent_mixture.description: Solvent mixture, with each component's fraction under its property map: volume_fraction (v/v) or mass_fraction (w/w), one basis per mixture.

material_spec_id.description: Optional canonical IRI of a standalone material-spec for the salt.

label.description: Preferred human-readable substance name stamped by the resolver (e.g. 'lithium hexafluorophosphate' for name 'LiPF6').

inchikey.description: Standard InChIKey of the salt — the canonical chemical-identity key. Stamped from the substances vocabulary at authoring; never hand-typed.

pubchem_cid.description: PubChem Compound ID (crosswalk; identity lives in inchikey).

smiles.description: Connectivity SMILES of the salt (dot-disconnected ionic form; identity lives in inchikey).

supplier.description: Supplier or vendor the item was sourced from.

property.description: Named quantity map of salt properties (e.g. concentration in mol/L; molality in mol/kg when given per solvent mass). See the property keys reference for the full list of recognised keys.

salt.description: Conducting salt (e.g. LiPF6), with concentration under its property map.

additive.description: Functional additives (e.g. VC, FEC). Each carries its mass_fraction of the total electrolyte under property, unless the component comment states another basis.

supplier.description: Supplier or vendor the item was sourced from.

property.description: Named quantity map of technical properties (snake_case key to value+unit quantity).
